item.title: Watch: Partial lunar eclipse visible overnight
item.description: The moon appeared reddish as Earth's shadow covered nearly all of its visible surface across much of North America.

item.title: Sheryl Crow honors Dolly Parton in tribute
item.description: Crow remembers the country music icon, who passed away on August 25 at age 80.

item.title: Court blocks new USPS mail voting rules temporarily
item.description: A federal judge on Thursday halted the Postal Service's new mail voting requirements for the November midterm elections.

item.title: Trump creates U.S. Space Academy via executive order
item.description: "Space is the hot thing," President Trump said at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston.
